milestone.title: mp test & code hygiene sweep — close shipped backlog items, fix B-46 raul test, consolidate scenarios, atomic strip rewrite, force-bypass evidence cleanup

intent.outcome: After this ships, backlog.json no longer carries items shipped by M104/M105 (B-39..B-45 resolved); the pre-existing raul `explain_impact.rs` test passes; overlapping `mp milestone create` tests are consolidated into one parameterized test; dead-code warnings in p6/p7 install bootstrap tests are trimmed; scenario/fixture overlap is consolidated; historical broad-scope AC verifications flagged by `make verify-lint` are resolved (post-M110 Rust linter); the 12 milestones carrying `[force-bypassed]` / `[skip-verify]` evidence strings are re-run clean or annotated; and `strip_dropped_keys_from_path` is atomic.

problem.description: Seven backlog items (B-39..B-45) are still marked `active` in backlog.json even though their work shipped in M104/M105 (verified: every AC on M104 AC-01..04 and M105 AC-01..06 is `passed`). This pollutes every grooming pass with already-done work. Separately, M106's testing-audit (B-46..B-50) surfaced five open test/code-hygiene items with no owner: B-46 (pre-existing raul `explain_impact.rs::raul_explain_impact_runs` failure — a broken test in the suite), B-47 (3 overlapping `mp milestone create` tests), B-48 (dead-code warnings in p6_install_bootstrap.rs / p7_optional_batch.rs), B-50 (p0 scenario/fixture overlap). B-49 (historical broad-scope AC verifications in M42/M99/M105 flagged by `make verify-lint`) needs M110's Rust linter shipped first. Twelve milestones (M32, M40, M41, M42, M44, M45, M47, M48, M77, M78, M104, M106) carry `[verification force-bypassed: ...]` / `[skip-verify: ...]` evidence strings — M107 R-5 explicitly chose to preserve them but never filed the follow-up to clean them. Two M105 code-review findings (entry 3 sub-8: `strip_dropped_keys_from_path` non-atomic; sub-9: `post_strip_validate_summary_stays_green` test asserts JSON validity, not the validate gate) are open with no owner. Each is small; collectively they're the accumulated test/code debt from the M100–M109 push. Post-grooming note: mp integration-test binary consolidation (148 files → 20 suite_* crates, ac_verify legacy --test rewrite, split-debuginfo) shipped ad-hoc in edc82a3; M114 still owns B-47/B-48/B-50 and the hygiene items in scope.

in_scope: Resolve B-39, B-40, B-41, B-42, B-43, B-44, B-45 in backlog.json via `mp backlog resolve`. Work shipped in M104 (B-42 sort, B-43 find_mp, B-44 lifecycle gates) and M105 (B-39 hit-test, B-40 rename, B-41 strip residue, B-45 confidence enum). Verified: every owning AC is `passed`. Resolution includes a one-line pointer to the shipping milestone + commit.

B-46: fix the pre-existing raul test failure `crates/raul/tests/explain_impact.rs::raul_explain_impact_runs` (missing spec_status after lifecycle migration). Fix the test (or the production code path), do not skip.
B-47: consolidate the 3 overlapping `mp milestone create` tests (`crates/mp/tests/suites/milestone_create*.rs`) into one parameterized test covering the same matrix.
B-48: trim dead-code warnings in `crates/mp/tests/suites/p6_install_bootstrap.rs` and `crates/mp/tests/suites/p7_optional_batch.rs`.
B-50: consolidate p0 scenario/fixture overlap (p0-validate-* vs fixtures, walkthrough-validate-ok vs walkthrough-oauth).

B-49: resolve historical broad-scope AC verification strings in M42/M99/M105 surfaced by `make verify-lint`. After M110 ships the Rust linter, narrow these verifications to the affected crates. Re-run `make verify-lint` clean.

Force-bypass/skip-verify evidence cleanup on 12 milestones (M32, M40, M41, M42, M44, M45, M47, M48, M77, M78, M104, M106). Either re-run `mp milestone complete <id>` clean (preferred, where the underlying ACs now pass) or annotate the evidence string explicitly explaining the bypass. M107 R-5 follow-up.
Entry 3 sub-8: atomic rewrite of `crates/mp/src/milestone.rs::strip_dropped_keys_from_path` via `tempfile::NamedTempFile::new_in(parent)?.persist(target)`. No behavioral change; crash-safe.

Entry 3 sub-9: fix the `post_strip_validate_summary_stays_green` test gap — either expand the fixture to a fully-validating plan (template from `tests/fixtures/projects/`) so the rust test can assert `error_count == 0`, or drop the test and rely on `m105-s4-verify.sh`.

B-52 (per-AC timeout hardening, ER-5) — owned by M117.
raul TUI polish (width<6 budget underflow) — owned by M115.
Meta-tooling (edit-tool batch counter, mp scratch docs, --files doc) — owned by M116.

FindingDraft struct refactor — added as an AC on M101.
Full mp integration-test suite consolidation (suite_* layout, integration_test_map.rs, ac_verify legacy --test rewrite, .cargo linker config) — shipped ad-hoc in edc82a3.
